create.name: Ziva Meditation
create.bio:
Ziva Meditation is the teaching company that Emily Fletcher started in 2011 after leaving a ten-year career on Broadway and spending three years training as a meditation teacher in India. Its core method, the Ziva Technique, joins three strands she calls mindfulness, meditation and manifesting, and is designed for people with full working and family lives rather than for monastic settings. Students learn it through zivaONLINE, a fifteen-day recorded course, and can go on to a short manifesting course and a longer embodied programme called Ziva Magic, which adds visualisation, breathwork and movement.

The YouTube channel, running since 2012, now mainly carries Fletcher's weekly podcast, Why Isn't Everyone Doing This?, in which she talks at length with teachers, mystics, writers and researchers about practices ranging from tantra and lucid dreaming to the sacred feminine and devotional life. Guests have included Meggan Watterson, Jess Magic, Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati and Alana Fairchild. Between episodes the channel posts guided visualisations led by Fletcher and short clips, and her book Stress Less, Accomplish More sets out the method in print.

courses.title: zivaONLINE (Ziva Meditation)
courses.description: A fifteen-day recorded training in the Ziva Technique, taught by Emily Fletcher in short daily videos with practice tasks. It covers the method's mindfulness, meditation and manifesting parts so students can keep practising alone afterwards.

courses.title: Ziva Magic
courses.description: A ten-week embodied manifesting programme that adds visualisation, breathwork, movement and what Ziva calls Pleasure Prayer to the basic practice. It comes with recorded lessons, guided practices and a members' community.

courses.title: Dream Magnet
courses.description: A short manifesting course meant as the next step after the core meditation training. It includes a recorded masterclass, a workbook and a guided manifesting audio, and can be finished in about three days.

free_resources.title: Test Drive Ziva Meditation (free 3-day preview)
free_resources.description: A free three-day introduction to the Ziva Technique, given as short lessons from Emily Fletcher. It lets newcomers try the method before taking the full course.

free_resources.title: Manifest Your Dreams audio
free_resources.description: A free guided audio from Ziva on directing attention towards what you want to create. It can be used with or without an existing Ziva practice.

Ziva is Emily Fletcher's company and podcast; Emily Fletcher is not on Spiritpedia, so this is listed as a channel. Owner may prefer an individual listing under her name.

Ziva's own pages sell the method heavily on stress, sleep and anxiety; the bio and items describe the practice only. The free 'Healing + Immunity' audios and the 'Abundant Sleep' course were left out.

The podcast page lists psychedelics, BDSM and sacred sexuality among its topics; the channel is not psychedelic-centred, but the owner may want to look. Episodes on mushrooms, functional medicine, perimenopause, trauma and fitness were left out.
